name: 77515 · Angleton, TX
findings: ZIP 77515 (Angleton) has 88 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77515 (Angleton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
45% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 77515 (Angleton) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 49% of the typical level).
